TermsPage.lastUpdated: Draft — not yet reviewed by counsel.

TermsPage.body:
1. Acceptance of terms
By creating an account or using Landlord without an account ("guest mode"), you agree to these Terms of Service.

2. The service
Landlord lets you record, measure, and store information about land plots you specify, including GPS boundaries, documents, and notes. You are solely responsible for the accuracy of any measurements, boundaries, or legal descriptions you enter — Landlord is a record-keeping tool, not a surveyor or legal authority, and nothing in the app constitutes legal or land-title advice.

3. Accounts and trial
New accounts receive a 14-day free trial. After the trial, continued access requires a one-time lifetime payment. Guest mode data is stored only in your browser and is not backed up by Landlord until you create an account and it migrates to your account.

4. Acceptable use
You may not use Landlord to store unlawfully obtained data, to misrepresent land ownership, or to interfere with the service's operation.

5. Termination
We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms.

6. Limitation of liability
Landlord is provided "as is." To the maximum extent permitted by law, we are not liable for losses arising from reliance on GPS-derived measurements, data loss, or service interruptions.

7. Changes
We may update these terms; continued use after an update constitutes acceptance.

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.lastUpdated: Draft — not yet reviewed by counsel.
PrivacyPage.draftNotice: DRAFT — this is placeholder text, not a final legal document. Do not rely on it until it has been reviewed and replaced.
PrivacyPage.body:
1. What we collect
Account data (name, email, phone), plot data you enter (location, boundaries, purchase/valuation details, notes, documents), and payment records for lifetime-access purchases.

2. Guest mode
If you use Landlord without an account, your plot data is stored only in your browser's local storage (IndexedDB) and is never sent to our servers unless and until you create an account, at which point it migrates to your account and this policy applies to it.

3. Client-side encryption
You may optionally enable client-side encryption for sensitive plot fields (village, mutation number, prices, dates, notes). When enabled, these fields are encrypted in your browser before being sent to our servers using a key derived from a passphrase only you know — we cannot read this data, and cannot recover it if you lose both your passphrase and recovery code.

4. How we use data
To provide the service, process payments (via SSLCommerz/bKash), and communicate essential account/service notices. We do not sell personal data.

5. Sharing
If you invite a collaborator to a plot, that collaborator can see the plot's non-encrypted data as described in-app. We may share data with service providers (hosting, payments) strictly to operate the service, and where required by law.

6. Data retention and deletion
You may delete plots and documents at any time. Contact us to request full account deletion.

7. Your rights
You may request a copy of your data or its deletion by contacting us.

RefundPage.title: Refund Policy
RefundPage.lastUpdated: Draft — not yet reviewed by counsel.
RefundPage.draftNotice: DRAFT — this is placeholder text, not a final legal document. Do not rely on it until it has been reviewed and replaced.
RefundPage.body:
1. Free trial
Every account includes a 14-day free trial with full access — no payment is collected during the trial, so there is nothing to refund during this period.

2. Lifetime access purchase
The one-time lifetime access payment is refundable within 7 days of purchase if you have not made substantial use of paid features beyond the trial, by contacting support with your payment reference.

3. How refunds are processed
Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method (via SSLCommerz or bKash) within 10 business days.

4. Non-refundable situations
Refunds are not available after 7 days, or where the account was suspended for violating the Terms of Service.

5. Contact
To request a refund, contact support with your registered email and payment transaction ID.

0.question: Is Landlord really free?
0.answer: Yes. Landlord is currently free to use, with no card or subscription required.

1.question: Can I try it without signing up?
1.answer: Yes. Guest mode lets you add and organise plots on this device. Create an account to move your guest records into your account. Browser storage can be cleared, so guest mode is not a backup.

2.question: What works without an internet connection?
2.answer: Guest property records are stored locally on your device. Previously viewed map tiles may be available offline. Signing in, cloud documents, and account updates need an internet connection.

3.question: Does a mapped boundary replace a land survey?
3.answer: No. Map boundaries help organise your records. They are not a legal survey or proof of ownership. Use verified documents and a qualified surveyor for legal or boundary decisions.
